Key.English:
The end of the weight bar. From here on, soldiers can only walk.
Always at least 1 kg above Overloaded.

Overloaded: no sprinting, and tiring faster the closer the load gets to Critical - up to half again as fast. Critical: walking only.
Off: the bar still shows the tiers, but nothing happens to the soldier.

Heavy, Overloaded and Critical: the colours of the weight bar, what they do to the soldier and the messages.
Off: the weight card shows only the kilograms, nothing of this mod slows a soldier down, and ACE's own fatigue is left as it is. The other weight settings then do nothing.

Where the weight bar turns yellow.
0 follows ACE's Advanced Fatigue: from the load at which ACE's jog costs more than the body can keep up - jogging tires you from there, and ACE blocks the sprint once you are worn out. It moves with ACE's load factor and the soldier's performance factor.
Any other value is a fixed weight. Never later than Overloaded.
Tell me when my load changes tier
A short message when you become Heavy, Overloaded or Critical, or lighter again, while the inventory is closed. Open, its weight bar shows it.

Where the weight bar turns red.
Overloaded soldiers cannot sprint and tire faster the closer they get to Critical - see Overload slows soldiers.
Arma's own full load is 45 kg.
